text:
mira: quick flag - CI artifact archive contained a plaintext S3 access key for staging-backups. redacted in our copy. need containment + rotation.
ops-bot: secret-detect v2.1: 1 match in ci-artifacts. report: https://internal/reports/1803332468 :warning:
ben: can you paste the redacted line and when it was last seen?
mira: line: `2026-03-23T09:12:03Z INFO upload complete bucket=staging-backups object=backup-2026-03-23.tar s3_key=****REDACTED****` last seen 2026-03-23T09:12:03Z
security_oncall: assume compromise. immediate plan: 1) disable the key in AWS console; 2) rotate key pair and update agents; 3) enforce RBAC: remove storage:Read from CI runner SA; 4) enable/confirm Vault/KMS audit export for the window; 5) open SEC-2026-42.
dan: notes - the key is stored in Vault at `secret/data/backups/staging/s3` (KVv2) version=5. I propose: create new path `secret/data/backups/staging/s3-rot1`, write new creds, update backup pipeline to read rot1, then delete old version. Use KMS envelope key `projects/redwood-kms/.../backup-rot`.
ben: quick commands to run: `aws iam update-access-key --user-name backup-runner --access-key-id AKIA... --status Inactive` then create new access key and push to Vault. Also patch k8s secret sync to read rot1 and restart pipeline.
mira: partner facing? no, internal staging only but blast radius includes partner ingestion tests. security_oncall: we still treat as incident. I'll file SEC-2026-42 and set a 30m check-in.
dan: vault policy deny draft (to apply immediately):
```
vault policy write deny-ci-backup - <<'EOF'
path "secret/data/backups/staging/s3" {
  capabilities = ["deny"]
}
EOF
```
ben: agree. I'll run the key disable + create new key workflow, kick the rotation job, and stage rollout to staging.
mira: after rotation please run a search across artifact storage and logs for other occurrences in the last 90 days.
security_oncall: post-rotation checklist: 1) delete old KV versions, 2) revoke any tokens that had access, 3) add alert for any reads to old path, 4) audit AWS CloudTrail for usage of the leaked key and share IOCs.
ops-bot: pipeline `rotations/backups/staging/1803332468` queued by ben. reminder in 30m.
ben: assigning tasks: ben -> rotate AWS key + CI update; dan -> vault path + tf diff for policy; mira -> artifact search + incident notes; security_oncall -> SEC ticket + audit hooks.
mira: thanks all, will attach PoA to SEC-2026-42 once done.
